今日もクリスマスパーティー本番に向けて、\nクララのサポートを泉花としている。:
Once again, Senka and I are helping Kurara
prepare for the Christmas party.
伴奏部分はまだ途中らしいが、歌の部分はすでにほぼできている。\nなので現在、先ん:
The accompaniment apparently still needs work, but the vocal part is nearly finished.
So Kurara is getting a head start on learning the lyrics and working on her singing.
当然泉花の曲もクララの歌声も、本場のプロからみると\nまだまだだろうが、俺からす:
A professional would probably say Senka's music and Kurara's singing
still have a long way to go, but I think they both sound great.
ねえ、みんなが休憩から戻ってきたら、\n気分転換に歌の練習場所、この教室から変え:
Hey, when everyone gets back from their break,
why don't we practice somewhere other than this classroom for a change?
場所替え？ そうだな……: A change of venue? Let's see...
中庭か……他の人に聞かれそうなのが少し不安ね。: The courtyard... I'm a little worried someone might hear me.
意外だな、むしろ『私の歌を聞け！』くらい言うかと思った。\nどうせ本番で聞かれる:
That's a surprise. I thought you'd be saying, "Listen to me sing!"

Well, you're part of the group...

な、なんでもない！ とにかく、中庭以外にしましょ！: N-nothing! Anyway, let's pick somewhere other than the courtyard!

いやぁ、いいツッコミしてくれるなぁ。: You're pretty good at shooting down my jokes.
